notes: Fixed the system diagnostics report in Repair. It used to open the Resource and Performance Monitor window, collect for a minute, and leave the PowerX console empty with no report to show, because the tool it ran is a GUI program that writes nothing back. PowerX now drives the same Windows collector directly: no window opens, the console counts down while it collects, and the finished HTML report opens on its own. Each run writes about 50 MB under C:\PerfLogs.
